- Windows: if MZGram 1.0.4 or older took tg:// links from Telegram Desktop, they go back to Telegram Desktop, also when only its installer knows where it is. Link handlers of other apps written with variables or without quotes are left alone, and a choice made with `registertg` stays after updates.
- Linux: MZGram becomes the app for tg://, tonsite:// and ton:// links only when no app has them; otherwise it is added to the apps these links can be opened with, and Telegram Desktop or the app chosen before stays the default.
- Linux: the self-update refuses an update archive with links or special files in it.
